papers.abstract: The research explores the knowledge existing in the and with the fishing communities of India and how does the state play its part to communicae with their knowledge and establishing its link with the market which also in othe way is the guardian of the both.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨印度渔业社区所拥有的知识体系，以及国家如何与其沟通并建立知识与市场的联系，同时国家也作为两者的守护者。通过政治经济学和话语建构视角，分析知识、市场与国家在印度渔业部门中的互动机制。研究发现，国家在整合地方性知识与市场逻辑中扮演关键角色，但存在知识传递与权力不对等的问题。

papers.title: Occurrence of Microplastics in Commercial Fish Species in Nigeria: A Case Study of Lower Usuma Dam and Jabi Lake, Federal Capital Territory, Abuja, Nigeria
papers.authors: Bulus, Michael; Etsuyankpa, Muhammad Binin; Usman, Abdullahi
papers.abstract: The emergence of microplastics pollution poses a significant environmental and health concern on freshwater ecosystems as well as human health, due to its persistence and potential ecological impacts. Microplastics contamination remains greatly under reported across the Nigerian aquatic ecosystem and as such, only limited data exist for the occurrence of microplastics in the region. This present study was carried to investigate for the first time, the occurrence of microplastics in Lower Usuma Dam and Jabi Lake in the Federal Capital Territory of Nigeria. The gastrointestinal tract of common commercial fish species in the locations Lates niloticus (Nile Perch) and Oreochromis niloticus (Nile Tilapia) were analyzed, and microplastics were found in 60% and 80% of each fish species collected from the two sampling locations. Similarly, a total of 71 microplastics particles were also recovered from water samples collected from the two locations confirming the prevalence of microplastics. Polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), and polystyrene (PS) were found in the surface water samples while Nylon (N), polyethylene terepthtalate (PET) were predominant in fishes collected. Generally, the shape distribution of microplastics particles were reported in the order fragment>foam>filament>film. Statistical analysis carried out showed no significant relationship between microplastics ingestion in different fish species and microplastics in the selected water bodies (P > 0.05). These findings highlight the need for further research in the region in other to identify and assess the full extent of microplastics pollution and how it affects the aquatic life as well as human health.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究首次调查了尼日利亚联邦首都特区Lower Usuma Dam和Jabi Lake中商业鱼类（尼罗河鲈鱼Lates niloticus和尼罗罗非鱼Oreochromis niloticus）的微塑料污染状况。通过分析鱼类胃肠道及水样，发现60%和80%的鱼类个体分别检出微塑料，水样中共回收71个微塑料颗粒，证实该区域微塑料普遍存在。表面水样中主要检出聚乙烯（PE）、聚丙烯（PP）和聚苯乙烯（PS），而鱼类体内以尼龙（N）和聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（PET）为主，颗粒形态分布为碎片>泡沫>纤维>薄膜。统计分析显示鱼类微塑料摄入与水体微塑料含量无显著相关性（P > 0.05），提示需进一步研究微塑料污染对水生生态和人类健康的潜在影响。

papers.title: Fish cell lines in aquaculture and biomedical research: A global perspective on development, repositories, and multidisciplinary applications
papers.authors: Kumar, Anand; Vimal, Bhartendu; Kumar, Vikash; Sarker, Sudeshna; Kumari, Pushpa; Paul, Tapas; Rout, Ajaya Kumar; Saini, Ved Prakash; Pandey, Pramod Kumar; Behera, Bijay Kumar
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了鱼类细胞系在水产养殖与生物医学研究中的全球发展现状，涵盖其建立、资源库及多学科应用。重点讨论了鱼类细胞系在病毒学、毒理学、免疫学及疾病防控中的关键作用，并展望了其在精准养殖和人类疾病模型中的潜力。研究强调建立标准化细胞库和共享机制对推动该领域发展的重要性。

papers.title:
Spatiotemporal Prediction
of River Fish Biodiversity
by Multimodal Deep Learning of eDNA and Satellite Imagery
papers.authors: Zhang, Song; Zhang, Xiaowei; Zhong, Wenjun; Wang, Yifan; Zong, Shuo; Pellissier, Loïc
papers.abstract: Abstract High-resolution spatiotemporal biodiversity maps are essential for conservation and environmental management of freshwater ecosystems. Yet existing eDNA-based approaches remain largely static and spatially extrapolative, discarding fine-grained landscape structure and overlooking interannual dynamics. Here, we developed a multimodal deep learning framework that integrates raw satellite imagery with environmental tabular covariates to predict fish species richness across river networks, using eDNA-derived richness from 1302 sites across six Chinese river basins as training labels. The framework couples a U-Net encoder–decoder with a novel water-guided spatial attention mechanism that leverages MNDWI-derived water masks to prioritize aquatic and riparian pixels, and an attention autoencoder that compresses high-dimensional environmental variables into a latent representation. Ablation experiments confirmed that multimodal fusion of imagery and tabular data substantially outperformed single-modality baselines (R2 from 0.54 to 0.76), and that the water-guided attention mechanism yielded further gains (R2 = 0.81), demonstrating that raw imagery preserves ecologically critical spatial information lost by conventional buffer-based summarization. The model was validated on fully independent basins (middle Yangtze and Yuan River) and multiyear field surveys (2018–2023). It achieved strong spatial transferability (r = 0.83 and 0.69) without region-specific retraining, and captured interannual recovery trends following the Yangtze fishing ban without any direct policy input. By shifting from static spatial extrapolation to prediction that generalizes across space and time, this framework offers a scalable pathway for freshwater biodiversity monitoring and conservation evaluation under the Kunming–Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究开发了一种多模态深度学习框架，整合卫星影像与环境表格数据预测河流鱼类物种丰富度，以中国六个流域1302个位点的eDNA数据为训练标签。该框架结合U-Net编码器-解码器与水引导空间注意力机制（利用MNDWI水掩膜优先处理水生和河岸像素），并通过注意力自编码器压缩高维环境变量。消融实验表明，多模态融合显著优于单模态基线（R²从0.54提升至0.76），水引导注意力机制进一步优化至R²=0.81；在独立流域（长江中游和沅江）及多年野外调查（2018–2023）中验证了强空间迁移性（r=0.83和0.69），并能捕捉长江禁渔后的年际恢复趋势。该框架从静态空间外推转向时空泛化预测，为淡水生物多样性监测和保护评估提供了可扩展路径。

papers.title: The importance of riverine islands: scaling and linking hydro-morphological and fish diversity in a very large river
papers.authors: Erős, T.; Feng, Kai; Tóth, B.; Sevcsik, A.; Szalóky, Z.
papers.abstract: Riverine islands are keystone geomorphic features that enhance hydro-morphological heterogeneity in large rivers; how island-associated main and side channels contribute to the taxonomic and functional diversity of fish assemblages in regulated rivers, however, remains poorly understood. Therefore, we applied a hierarchical spatial framework to examine how hydro-morphological variation between main and side channels would structure fish assemblages along three islands in the Middle Danube (Hungary). Principal component analyses of physical habitat variables revealed that main channel habitats were characterized by higher velocities and coarser substrates, whereas side channels exhibited slower flow, finer sediments, and greater macrophyte and herbaceous cover. Overall, habitat-type effects in physical structure were stronger and more consistent than regional differences among islands. Shoreline electrofishing revealed pronounced differences in fish assemblages associated with hydro-morphological variation. Specifically, rarefaction analyses justified higher species richness in side channels and complementarity between habitat types, indicating that each harbored some unique species that contributed to gamma diversity. Multivariate analyses demonstrated clear separation in the taxonomic structure of fish assemblages between main and side channels. Functional analyses mirrored taxonomic patterns, showing distinct trait compositions along hydro-morphological gradients. Velocity and substrate composition emerged as the key environmental drivers that structure both taxonomic and functional structure, thus highlighting the importance of hydro-morphological heterogeneity. Our findings identify riverine islands and their side channels as biodiversity amplifiers that sustain lateral habitat complexity and increase hydro-morphological, taxonomic, and functional diversity in regulated large rivers. Protecting and restoring island–side-channel complexes should therefore be prioritized in process-based river restoration strategies, such as the EU Nature Restoration Regulation, to counteract habitat homogenization and enhance lateral connectivity and functional resilience.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了大型河流中河心岛对水文地貌异质性和鱼类多样性的促进作用，聚焦于多瑙河中游三个岛屿的主河道与侧河道生境差异。通过主成分分析和河岸电渔采样，发现侧河道具有更细的底质、更缓的水流及更高的水生植被覆盖，且鱼类物种丰富度和功能多样性显著高于主河道，两者互补贡献了γ多样性。流速和底质组成是驱动鱼类分类和功能结构的关键环境因子，表明河心岛及其侧河道是调节性河流中维持横向连通性和生物多样性的核心地貌特征。研究建议在欧盟自然恢复法规等基于过程的河流修复策略中，优先保护和恢复岛屿-侧河道复合体，以缓解生境均质化并增强生态功能韧性。

papers.title: Improving Fish Production and Nutrition in South Sudan: A Pathway to Food Security and Sustainable Development
papers.authors: Alosias, John; Garang, Albino
papers.journal: International Journal of Innovative Science and Research Technology
papers.abstract: This study explored the status and potential of South Sudan’s rich fisheries resources to enhance food security and sustainable development through improved fish production and nutrition. Despite the abundant aquatic resources in South Sudan, the fisheries sector remains underdeveloped and characterized by artisanal practices, limited infrastructure and policy gaps that restrict productivity as well as accessibility. Fish plays a critical role in household nutrition by providing high-quality protein, essential micronutrients and omega-3 fatty acids that all have the potential to alleviate malnutrition and food insecurity. But challenges such as political and fishing conflicts, climate variability, poor market access and cultural barriers hinder the growth of the fisheries sector in South Sudan. This desk review research, therefore, synthesized secondary data to assess the current status, challenges and opportunities in the fisheries sector in South Sudan. As a result, the importance of multifaceted interventions including aquaculture development, modernization of fishing practices, infrastructure investment, policy reform, and nutrition education were highlighted and emphasized. Upgrading production and postharvest related activities is considered a pathway towards improving nutrition, economic empowerment and resilience for vulnerable communities in South Sudan. Furthermore, the study appealed for integrated approaches and further research investigations to realize the full potential of the fisheries sector in contributing to national food security and sustainable development.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过综述二手数据，评估了南苏丹渔业资源现状、挑战与机遇，旨在提升鱼类生产和营养以促进粮食安全与可持续发展。研究发现，尽管水产资源丰富，但渔业受制于手工捕捞、基础设施不足和政策缺口，且面临政治冲突、气候多变及市场准入障碍。文章强调，多层面干预措施（如 aquaculture development、捕捞现代化、基础设施投资、政策改革和营养教育）是改善脆弱社区营养、经济赋权和韧性的关键路径，并呼吁综合策略与进一步研究以释放渔业部门潜力。

papers.title: Nitrogen Metabolism and Pathogen Feedback in Intensive Aquaculture: Reframing Ammonia Nitrogen as a Reactive Node
papers.authors: Yu, Junfei; Yang, Hongling; Cai, Guohe; Xia, Banghua; Sun, Yunzhang
papers.abstract: Feeds rich in protein are the dominant nitrogen input in intensive aquaculture, yet only part of dietary nitrogen is retained as animal biomass; the remainder enters water and sediment through uneaten feed, feces, dissolved wastes, mucus, sloughed tissue, and branchial ammonia excretion. This review aims to integrate nutritional, physiological, microbial, and disease-related evidence into an evidence-graded framework that positions ammonia nitrogen as a reactive node linking feed, host, water, sediment, and pathogen risk. To assemble this evidence, we conducted a structured narrative search of Web of Science and PubMed for records in English or Chinese published from 2006 to July 2026, with no restriction on publication type, and classified evidence as direct, indirect, or conceptual. The strongest evidence shows that dietary protein supply, amino acid balance, digestibility, and feeding regime regulate nitrogen retention and ammonia output, while microbial ammonification, nitrification, denitrification, dissimilatory nitrate reduction to ammonium, anammox, and assimilation determine whether reactive nitrogen is regenerated, retained, or removed. Experimental studies further show that ammonia impairs oxidative balance, mucosal barriers, immunity, and disease resistance. In contrast, evidence that pathogen infection quantitatively alters nitrogen retention, ammonia excretion, organic nitrogen release, and sedimentary ammonium regeneration remains limited and largely indirect. Accordingly, ammonia nitrogen is framed as a measurable reactive node rather than a unique source or a universally validated causal loop. Practical management should combine precision nutrition with water, biofloc, sediment, and disease surveillance, while future factorial studies and isotope tracer studies should quantify the complete nitrogen budget under pathogen challenge.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述整合营养学、生理学、微生物学及病害学证据，提出将氨氮视为集约化养殖中连接饲料、宿主、水体、沉积物和病原风险的“反应节点”。基于2006至2026年间Web of Science和PubMed的结构化检索，证据分级显示：饲料蛋白供应、氨基酸平衡及投喂策略调控氮保留与氨输出，而微生物氨化、硝化及反硝化等过程决定活性氮的去向；实验证实氨氮损害氧化平衡、黏膜屏障和免疫抗病力，但病原感染对氮收支的定量影响证据有限且多为间接。建议将精准营养与水质、生物絮团、沉积物及病害监测相结合，并采用因子设计和同位素示踪量化病原胁迫下的完整氮预算。

papers.title: Ontogenetic shifts in salinity tolerance and metabolic strategies of Heliocidaris crassispina: implications for aquaculture management
papers.authors: Li, Zirui; Sun, Qiyang; Su, Dejian; Ming, Yang; Wen, Junyi; Yu, Zonghe
papers.summary_cn: 标题研究海胆（Heliocidaris crassispina）的盐度耐受性与代谢策略随个体发育的变化，旨在为养殖管理提供依据。研究发现其盐度适应能力和代谢模式随生长阶段显著改变，提示养殖需分阶段调控盐度条件。该结果对优化海胆人工育苗及成体养殖的水环境管理具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Understanding women’s participation in northeastern oyster aquaculture
papers.authors: Lord, Natalie; Ashcraft, Catherine; Novak-Colwell, Julia; Williams, Lindsey; White, Easton R.
papers.abstract: The increasing participation of women aquaculture producers brings diverse perspectives and innovative solutions to the industry in the Northeastern United States. However, without baseline demographic data of the workforce, we lack comprehensive understanding of resource management, distribution of benefits, and equitable access to the seafood system. A mixed methods approach including a survey and the participatory research method, photovoice, was implemented to characterize demographics and understand gender dynamics of the Maine and New Hampshire oyster aquaculture industry. A gender analysis was conducted to investigate how women access resources and navigate barriers to participation as oyster producers. The food systems concept was used to investigate a gender division of labor in the oyster aquaculture industry. Results indicate that established gender norms create systemic barriers for women-owned oyster businesses including gender discrimination and insufficient access to funding, targeted training, and farm equipment. Women leveraged female-led social networks to learn about growing methods that addressed affordability, occupational safety, and production efficiency on their farms. To maintain autonomy over decision making and avoid gendered outcomes, women participate in all activities of the food system, from oyster production to market sales, indicating no gender division of labor. This paper argues that women oyster farmers experience gender-specific obstacles due to cultural norms of the maritime industry that have traditionally supported only men. More work is required to build data informed policy mechanisms and institutional support systems that ensure equitable participation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查美国东北部女性参与牡蛎养殖的现状，采用混合方法（问卷调查与photovoice参与式研究）分析缅因州和新罕布什尔州牡蛎养殖业的性别动态。研究发现，传统性别规范为女性养殖户带来系统性障碍，包括性别歧视及资金、培训和设备获取不足；女性通过女性主导的社会网络学习养殖技术，并参与从生产到销售的全链条活动以保持决策自主权。论文指出，海洋产业文化传统上偏向男性，需建立数据驱动的政策机制和制度支持以确保公平参与。

papers.title: Wild-harvesting of the fucoid Fucus vesiculosus (Phaeophyceae) at an active oyster aquaculture site
papers.authors: Cunningham, Eoghan Mánus; Maggs, Christine A.; Walsh, Pamela J.
papers.abstract: Macroalgae are seen as a sustainable resource for industries including agriculture, food, and nutraceuticals. Aquaculture is the dominant form of global seaweed biomass production, yet wild-harvesting remains important in Europe. Fucoid species such as Fucus vesiculosus commonly colonise intertidal shores and artificial structures, including oyster farms in Ireland, where they represent a largely unexploited biomass resource. However, the amount of biomass produced annually on oyster farms is unknown, making it unclear whether this resource could be harvested sustainably and potentially provide a new opportunity for shellfish farmers. Hence, this study investigated the potential for sustainable harvesting by management of F. vesiculosus fouling on an oyster aquaculture site, quantifying post-harvest seaweed biomass yield and regeneration. F. vesiculosus thalli were harvested under three treatments, a control (no cut), a longer cut to ~6 cm (Cut L) and a shorter cut to ~3.5 cm (Cut S) and regrowth was quantified over a 12-month period from April 2025 to 2026. The harvested F. vesiculosus thalli regenerated up to 87% of pre-harvest lengths within 12 months. The thalli showed non-linear seasonal growth patterns, with thallus lengths increasing over time. The Cut S treatment resulted in a higher relative growth rate among treatments and a greater initial biomass yield of 0.54 kg per m of trestle. Having determined the total number of oyster trestles in a 1 km stretch of shoreline, we estimated that ~11 tonnes of biomass could be harvested using the Cut S treatment. Our results suggest that low intensity partial harvesting of settled F. vesiculosus on oyster farms could be sustainable, and our results provide proof-of-concept for future co-location of Fucus crops and oysters within a shellfish aquaculture site.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了在爱尔兰牡蛎养殖场主动采收野生墨角藻（Fucus vesiculosus）的可持续性，旨在量化其生物量产量与再生能力。通过设置对照、长切（~6 cm）和短切（~3.5 cm）三种处理，在12个月内监测再生情况，发现藻体可恢复至采收前长度的87%，且短切处理相对生长率最高，初始生物量达0.54 kg/m养殖架。基于1 km海岸线的牡蛎架总数，估算短切处理可收获约11吨生物量。结果表明，低强度部分采收养殖区附生墨角藻具有可持续性，为未来贝藻共养提供了概念验证。

papers.title: Amino Acids in the Natural Food Web of Global Fishponds: Way Forward for Precision Protein Feeding in Pond Cyprinid Aquaculture
papers.authors: Hossain, Md. Foysul; Sezimova, Katerina; Mraz, Jan; Gebauer, Radek; Zabransky, Lubos; Roy, Koushik
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Natural food webs in freshwater pond ecosystems provide an important nutritional foundation for cyprinid aquaculture, yet information on their protein and amino acid composition remains fragmented. This review synthesized published data from 30 studies (1950–2026) reporting protein and indispensable amino acid (IAA) composition of freshwater natural food resources, including algae, zooplankton, and zoobenthos. Protein and IAA concentrations were standardized on a dry matter basis and evaluated relative to common carp ( Cyprinus carpio ) amino acid requirement benchmarks. Natural food protein quantity and quality followed the trophic pattern zooplankton > zoobenthos > algae. The IAA profiles in zooplankton and zoobenthos mostly met or exceeded common carp dietary benchmarks, unlike algae which may fall short. Relative trophic position (RTP) was positively associated with all IAAs, supporting the concept of trophic upgrading within freshwater food webs. Lysine exhibited the strongest relationship with RTP ( R 2 = 0.551), demonstrating a high sensitivity to natural food choices by pond carp, whereas methionine showed the weakest relationship, strictly controlled across trophic levels, making it one of the most difficult IAAs to source in pond food web. Our analysis suggests that any ideal protein concept for supplementary feed for ponds should be centered around methionine (as denominator), as most supplementary pond feed protein ingredients may exacerbate the methionine deficiencies and undermine protein utilization. A nutritional ecology framework integrating food web IAA into precision pond feed, with complementary ingredient choices, can greatly enhance the efficiency and cleanliness of pond aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究系统综述了1950–2026年间30项研究，分析了全球鱼塘自然食物网（藻类、浮游动物、底栖动物）的蛋白质和必需氨基酸（IAA）组成，并以鲤鱼氨基酸需求为基准进行评价。结果显示，自然食物蛋白质数量和质量呈浮游动物>底栖动物>藻类的营养级模式，浮游动物和底栖动物的IAA谱基本满足或超过鲤鱼需求，而藻类可能不足。赖氨酸与相对营养级位置（RTP）关联最强（R²=0.551），蛋氨酸关联最弱且在各营养级严格受控，成为鱼塘食物网中最难获取的IAA。据此建议，池塘补充饲料的理想蛋白概念应以蛋氨酸为分母，因多数补充蛋白源可能加剧蛋氨酸缺乏，整合食物网IAA的营养生态学框架可提升精准投喂效率和养殖清洁度。

papers.title: California salmon returns track deteriorating freshwater and marine conditions
papers.authors: Munsch, Stuart H.; Greene, Correigh; Satterthwaite, William H
papers.journal: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: Climate change and human activities are pushing aquatic ecosystems into novel states; therefore, it is crucial to understand how ecosystem conditions affect fish. We quantified relationships between ecological conditions and recruitment for three California Chinook salmon stocks. Using linear and generalized additive models across rolling time windows, we identified indicators of freshwater and marine conditions that were persistently or recently important to recruitment (i.e., adult returns). We found that recruitment was higher following years with abundant natural area spawners, high outmigration flows, cool outmigration and incubation temperatures, low marine predator buffering, and positive NPGO phases. Inspection of these indicators across time revealed that ecosystem conditions have deteriorated over the past two decades, characterized by rising watershed temperatures, droughts, pulses of low marine predator buffering, and negative NPGO phases. Our results bolster prior research suggesting California’s salmon production system of worsening climate conditions and degraded habitats exemplifies a shifted ecological baseline. Ultimately, our work contributes to understanding why California’s salmon have performed poorly recently and an ecosystem perspective that informs decisions and expectations.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究量化了加州三种奇努克鲑（Chinook salmon）种群的生态条件与补充量（成鱼回归）之间的关系，采用线性模型和广义加性模型在滚动时间窗口内识别关键淡水与海洋环境指标。结果显示，高补充量出现在自然产卵区丰富、出流流量大、孵化和迁徙温度较低、海洋捕食缓冲低及NPGO正相位年份。过去二十年生态系统条件持续恶化，表现为流域升温、干旱、低捕食缓冲脉冲和负NPGO相位，印证了加州鲑鱼生产系统面临气候恶化与栖息地退化的生态基线偏移，为近期鲑鱼表现不佳提供了机制解释。

papers.title: Functional probiotic attributes of Bacillus subtilis ULB16, an endophyte isolated from marine macroalga, Ulva lactuca
papers.authors: Anand, Swathy Sadanandan; Hely, Sreetha; Nair, Bipin Gopalakrishnan; Nair, Sudarslal Sadasivan; Prakash, Vidhya; Pai, Jayashree Gopalakrishna
papers.abstract: Marine-derived probiotic bacteria have emerged as promising alternatives to antibiotics in sustainable aquaculture owing to their resilience, metabolic versatility, and ability to produce beneficial bioactive compounds. In the present study, the probiotic and functional potential of Bacilllus subtilis ULB16, a marine endophytic bacterium isolated from Ulva lactuca , was comprehensively evaluated. The safety assessment revealed susceptibility to several clinically relevant antibiotics, while no extracellular DNase activity was detected, supporting its non-virulent nature. The strain exhibited tolerance to gastrointestinal-like stress conditions, including acidic pH, bile salts, and simulated gastric juice, indicating its ability to survive gastrointestinal transit. Functional probiotic characterization demonstrated cell surface hydrophobicity, auto-aggregation, and co-aggregation with representative enteric pathogens ( Escherichia coli , Salmonella enterica , and Klebsiella pneumoniae ) as well as aquaculture-associated pathogens ( Aeromonas hydrophila and Vibrio parahaemolyticus ). B. subtilis ULB16 also exhibited biofilm-forming ability and showed higher adhesion to HT-29 intestinal epithelial cells than the commercial probiotic strain Alkalihalobacillus clausii. Notably, the isolate exhibited β-galactosidase activity of 0.0565 U/mL, a relatively uncommon feature among Bacillus -based probiotics, suggesting additional nutritional and functional benefits associated with lactose metabolism. Collectively, the findings demonstrate that B. subtilis ULB16 possesses a combination of desirable probiotic traits, including stress tolerance, pathogen interaction capability, epithelial adhesion, and functional enzyme activity. These multifunctional properties highlight its potential as a promising marine-derived probiotic candidate for sustainable biotechnological applications.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究从海洋大型藻类石莼（Ulva lactuca）中分离出内生菌Bacillus subtilis ULB16，并全面评估其益生潜力。该菌株对临床相关抗生素敏感、无DNase活性，且耐受酸性pH、胆盐及模拟胃液等胃肠道胁迫条件。功能表征显示其具备细胞表面疏水性、自聚集及与肠道病原菌（大肠杆菌、肠炎沙门氏菌、肺炎克雷伯菌）和水产病原菌（嗜水气单胞菌、副溶血弧菌）的共聚集能力，同时表现出生物膜形成及对HT-29肠上皮细胞的强黏附性。值得注意的是，该菌株具有β-半乳糖苷酶活性（0.0565 U/mL），这在Bacillus益生菌中较为罕见，提示其额外的乳糖代谢营养功能，可作为可持续水产养殖中具有应用前景的海洋源益生菌候选菌株。

papers.title: Sustainable Integrated Multi‐Trophic Aquaculture: Key Considerations for Assessing Environmental and Economic Performance
papers.authors: Hornborg, Sara; Capoccioni, Fabrizio; Irz, Xavier; Langeland, Markus; Martini, Arianna; Pulcini, Domitilla; Salenius, Fredrik; Ziegler, Friederike
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Integrated multi‐trophic aquaculture (IMTA), defined as the co‐production of species at different trophic levels, is conceptually appealing. By utilising complementary functions of different species, it holds opportunities for lower environmental impact, higher productivity, and increased profitability in comparison with conventional monoculture. However, whether those advantages materialise in practice remains unclear. Here we review available life cycle assessment (LCA) and cost–benefit analysis (CBA) studies of IMTAs to further the current understanding of environmental and economic performance. We find that, overall, LCAs conclude that IMTAs investigated have not been able to deliver on environmental promises, while CBAs generally find that IMTAs have both better financial performance and lower environmental externalities than monoculture equivalents. The main reasons for these contrasting findings include the nature of the systems assessed so far—often theoretical or experimental set‐ups with non‐optimised designs—combined with methodological choices in assessments. The findings of the review thus suggest that it is still unclear to what extent IMTA can deliver on its promises in practice, and that IMTA is no panacea for aquaculture but requires careful design to be effective for its intended use. Integrating robust LCAs and CBAs early in the development phase can help identify viable IMTA set‐ups based on key drivers of environmental and economic performance and, in this way, minimise the risks of misaligned practices. A first step towards realising the potential of IMTA is to carry out robust assessments that avoid key mistakes in both LCAs and CBAs, to which end we provide hands‐on recommendations for future assessments.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了综合多营养级水产养殖（IMTA）的环境与经济绩效评估研究，通过分析生命周期评估（LCA）和成本效益分析（CBA）文献发现，LCA显示IMTA未显著降低环境影响，而CBA则表明其财务表现和外部性优于单养。研究指出，评估结果差异源于系统设计非优化和方法选择，强调IMTA并非万能，需早期整合LCA和CBA以识别可行方案，并为未来评估提供实践建议。

papers.title: A computational framework for Kármán gaiting in robotic fish: spatio-temporal perception and CPG-based reinforcement learning
papers.authors: Wang, Xinqi; Wang, Ming; Liu, Xinyang; Pan, Sida; Wang, Feige; Yu, Junzhi
papers.abstract: Abstract Navigating in unsteady wake flows, such as Kármán vortex streets, presents a formidable challenge for biomimetic autonomous underwater vehicles. Biological fish achieve this by utilizing their lateral line sensory systems to perceive local flow gradients and adopting an energy-efficient swimming pattern known as the Kármán gait. To translate this biological phenomenon into a practical robotics engineering solution, this paper proposes a fully computational framework focusing on the modeling and simulation of a spatio-temporal sensory system to autonomously generate the Kármán gait. To overcome the unrealistic assumption of full-state observability common in existing reinforcement learning studies, we model a multi-point lateral line array coupled with a frame-stacking mechanism. This allows the simulated agent to reconstruct the spatio-temporal topology of the surrounding unsteady flow relying exclusively on local pressure and velocity gradients. The sensory model is integrated with a spatio-temporal perceptual twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient (STP-TD3) algorithm, which drives a Hopf-oscillator-based central pattern generator. Through rigorous high-fidelity computational fluid dynamics simulations, we quantitatively evaluate the autonomous emergence of the Kármán gait by assessing the agent’s kinematic energy proxy-mapped from joint actuation effort. Results reveal that the agent expends significantly less mechanical effort navigating through the turbulent vortex street compared to swimming in steady water, suggesting the active exploitation of the local wake dynamics. The results theoretically underscore the necessity of distributed STP for biomimetic robots, providing a robust algorithmic blueprint for future physical deployments in complex aquatic environments.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究提出一种计算框架，用于实现仿生机器鱼在Kármán涡街中的自主游动（Kármán gait）。通过模拟多点侧线感知系统结合帧堆叠机制，重构非定常流场的时空拓扑，并集成基于Hopf振荡器的中央模式发生器与STP-TD3强化学习算法。高保真CFD仿真显示，该智能体在涡街中游动所需机械功显著低于静水环境，表明其主动利用了局部尾流动力学。结果强调分布式时空感知对仿生机器人的必要性，为复杂水环境中的物理部署提供了算法蓝图。

papers.title:
Detecting
                    <scp>LED</scp>
                    Colors from Underwater Video Images for Visible Light Communication in a Fish Farm Monitoring System
papers.authors: Taniguchi, Yoshiaki; Kurasawa, Reon
papers.journal: IEEJ Transactions on Electrical and Electronic Engineering
papers.abstract: This letter proposes an underwater visible light communication system using low‐cost devices for real‐time fish farm monitoring. The system transmits data using four‐color shift keying with blue, red, green, and white LED lights. To decode the signals from captured video, in this letter, a two‐stage method is proposed: YOLOv8 detects LED positions, and ResNet18 classifies their colors. Experimental evaluations conducted across four distinct underwater environments demonstrate high detection and color estimation accuracy under various turbidities and distances. Furthermore, the processing speed reaches 69 fps, confirming its capability for real‐time aquaculture applications. © 2026 Institute of Electrical Engineers of Japan and Wiley Periodicals LLC.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究提出一种面向水产养殖实时监控的水下可见光通信系统，利用低成本设备实现数据传输。系统采用四色键控（蓝、红、绿、白LED）编码信号，并通过两阶段解码方法：YOLOv8检测LED位置，ResNet18分类颜色。在四种不同水下环境（不同浊度和距离）下的实验表明，该方法具有较高的检测与颜色估计精度，处理速度达69 fps，满足实时水产养殖应用需求。

papers.title: Metals and metalloids in frequently consumed fish species from Koka and Aba Samuel Reservoirs in central Ethiopia
papers.authors: Dessie, Bitew K.; Aschale, Minbale; Kassegne, Alemnew Berhanu
papers.abstract: Abstract The deposition of Metals and metalloids in freshwater has direct impacts on the ecosystem’s health. Consequently, the objective of the present study was to determine the levels of metals and metalloids in the organs of freshwater fish species from Lake Koka and Aba Samuel Reservoir in Ethiopia in February and August 2023. The analysis was performed using an ICP-OES after the hot plate digestion. Statistical analyses indicated that the metal levels in fish organs differed significantly ( p < 0.05). The mean build-up trend of these elements in the organs of fish was liver > gill > muscle. There exists a substantial difference in the accumulation of Metals and metalloids in muscle and liver ( p < 0.05). The trace metal accumulation pattern for fish types was C. carpio > C. gariepinus > O. niloticus . Seasonal variation of the trace metal concentrations in fish organs indicated elevated concentrations in the dry season. The findings demonstrate that metals and metalloids accumulate in fish from Lake Koka and Aba Samuel Reservoir, with Pb exceeding permissible limits in some samples. Although health risk assessment indicated generally acceptable non-carcinogenic and carcinogenic risks, elevated Pb levels and widespread metal occurrence warrant continuous monitoring and management to protect ecosystem and public health.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究测定了埃塞俄比亚Koka湖和Aba Samuel水库常见淡水鱼（2023年2月及8月采样）器官中金属及类金属含量，采用ICP-OES分析。结果显示，金属在鱼体内蓄积趋势为肝脏>鳃>肌肉，且鲤鱼（C. carpio）积累量高于胡子鲶（C. gariepinus）和罗非鱼（O. niloticus），旱季浓度显著升高。部分样品中Pb含量超出允许限值，虽健康风险评估总体可接受，但鉴于金属广泛存在，需持续监测与管理以保障生态和公共健康。

papers.title: Acoustic and multimodal deterrents to limit invasive fish passage
papers.authors: Mensinger, Allen F
papers.abstract: Abstract Acoustic deterrents have been deployed with variable success to decrease fish interactions with anthropogenic hazards (i.e., power plant intakes, spillways) and prevent the spread of invasive species. Acoustic deterrents are nonphysical barriers that offer many advantages in that sound can travel a great distance, are relatively independent of light and weather conditions, do not interfere with navigation and are relatively inexpensive to implement. Assessing the efficacy of deterrents is challenging as there are few controlled or long-term studies and many reports fail to specify sound parameters (i.e., intensity, frequency) preventing independent assessment. It is imperative to factor fish sensory physiology when designing nonphysical deterrents as fish need to detect, localize and move away from the stimulus. The auditory sensitivity of the target species must be identified to optimize the acoustic stimulus and the ambient soundscape mapped to ensure the sound intensity will be effective. Animals may habituate to an aversive stimulus and therefore multimodal deterrents may prove more effective than single modal systems. This paper will provide an overview of acoustic deterrents, species targeted and their efficacy. Special emphasis will be given to efforts to block the upstream migration of invasive bigheaded carp in the Mississippi River basin that currently threatens the Laurentian Great Lakes. Recent studies using a multimodal acoustic deterrent that conditions fish to associate sound with carbon dioxide will be described.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究综述了声学威慑在限制入侵鱼类通过中的应用，旨在评估其效果并优化设计。方法上强调需结合目标鱼类的听觉敏感性和环境声景，并探讨多模态威慑（如声与二氧化碳结合）的潜力。主要发现是声学威慑效果因物种和参数而异，长期控制需避免习惯化，多模态系统更有效。重点案例为密西西比河流域阻断入侵大头鲤（bigheaded carp）上游迁移，以保护五大湖。

papers.title: Marine Protein Sources and Lipid Levels in Microdiets Affect the Survival and Health of Whiteleg Shrimp (Penaeus vannamei) Post-Larvae in Clear-Water Recirculating Aquaculture Systems
papers.authors: Barreto, André; Peixoto, Diogo; Fajardo, Carlos; Pires, Sílvia; Pinto, Wilson; Rocha, Rui J. M.; Conceição, Luís E. C.; Costas, Benjamín
papers.abstract: This study evaluated the effects of different marine protein sources and dietary lipid levels in inert microdiets for whiteleg shrimp (Penaeus vannamei) post-larvae (PL) reared in clear-water recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS). Five diets were evaluated: a control diet containing a blend of fish and squid meals, diets based on fish meal, squid meal, or krill meal as the main marine ingredient, and a high-lipid fish meal-based formulation used to assess the effect of increased dietary lipid content. After 21 days, growth performance did not differ significantly among treatments. However, survival and physiological status were significantly affected by diet. PL fed the control and krill-based diets showed higher survival (76.5 and 78.0%, respectively), whereas survival was lowest with the high-lipid fish meal-based diet (41.5%), which also resulted in an increased feed conversion ratio (FCR). Fatty acid composition reflected dietary inputs, with higher levels of n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids in PL fed the high-lipid diet. Biomarker and gene expression analyses revealed modulation of antioxidant and immune responses in PL fed single-ingredient diets and the high-lipid formulation, suggesting increased physiological stress compared to the control and krill-based treatments. These results show that growth alone is not sufficient to assess diet adequacy. The use of combined marine protein sources or krill meal was associated with higher survival, while increasing dietary lipid content from 14 to 16% did not improve growth performance and was associated with reduced survival.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了不同海洋蛋白源及脂肪水平对凡纳滨对虾（Penaeus vannamei）仔虾在清水循环水养殖系统中微颗粒饲料的存活与健康影响。21天实验显示，各处理间生长性能无显著差异，但存活率和生理状态受饲料显著影响：对照组（鱼粉+鱿鱼粉混合）和磷虾粉组存活率最高（76.5%和78.0%），而高脂鱼粉组存活率最低（41.5%）且饲料转化率升高。脂肪酸组成反映饲料输入，高脂组仔虾n-3多不饱和脂肪酸含量更高；生物标志物和基因表达分析表明，单一蛋白源及高脂配方诱导抗氧化和免疫应答调节，提示生理应激增强。结果表明，仅凭生长不足以评估饲料适宜性，混合海洋蛋白源或磷虾粉可提高存活率，而将脂肪水平从14%增至16%未改善生长并降低存活。

papers.title: Effects of Catfish Aquaculture Effluents on Soil Physicochemical  Properties and Microbial Community Structure in Peri-Urban  Agricultural Soils of Owerri, Southeastern Nigeria
papers.authors: D., Ekotogbo; I., Nwachukwu J.; C., Ejiogu C.
papers.journal: Research Journal of Pure Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Intensive catfish (Clariasgariepinus) aquaculture in peri-urban Owerri, southeastern Nigeria, generates nutrient-rich effluents that are routinely discharged onto adjacent farmland, yet the consequences for tropical soil chemistry and microbiology remain poorly documented. This study characterized catfish pond effluents from six farms and compared soil physicochemical properties and bacterial community composition between effluent treated soils and three unexposed control sites in Owerri Municipal. Effluents were near neutral to slightly alkaline (pH 6.72-7.58) and moderately loaded with nitrogen (18.4-52.7 mg/L), phosphorus (2.47-7.89 mg/L) and organic matter (BOD/COD ratio 0.51). Relative to controls, effluent-treated surface soils (0-10 cm) showed significantly higher pH (6.18 versus 5.48), electrical conductivity, organic matter (+48%), total nitrogen (+66%), available phosphorus (nearly threefold), exchangeable bases and cation exchange capacity (+39%), while heavy metals (Pb, Cd, Cr, Ni, Cu, Zn) remained below international safe limits for agricultural soils. High-throughput 16S rRNA gene sequencing of 45 soil samples revealed that effluent application significantly reduced bacterial alpha diversity (19% reduction in observed amplicon sequence variants; p < 0.001) and restructured community composition, with copiotrophicProteobacteria, Bacteroidetes and Firmicutes expanding at the expense of oligotrophic Acidobacteria, Chloroflexi, Verrucomicrobia and Planctomycetes. Soil pH, total nitrogen and available phosphorus were the strongest correlates of community dissimilarity (Mantel r = 0.57, 0.52 and 0.49, respectively; p < 0.001). These findings show that catfish effluent application confers clear short-term fertility benefits in acidic, weathered tropical soils but simultaneously simplifies soil microbial communities, indicating a fertility-diversity trade-off that should inform effluent management guidelines, extension advice and environmental policy for peri-urban aquaculture-agriculture integration in sub-Saharan Africa.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了尼日利亚东南部Owerri城郊农业土壤中鲶鱼（Clarias gariepinus）养殖废水对土壤理化性质和微生物群落结构的影响。通过比较六个养殖场废水处理土壤与三个未暴露对照点的样品，发现废水呈近中性至微碱性（pH 6.72-7.58），富含氮、磷和有机质，显著提高了表层土壤（0-10 cm）的pH、电导率、有机质（+48%）、总氮（+66%）、有效磷（近三倍）和阳离子交换量（+39%），而重金属含量低于国际农业安全限值。基于45个土壤样本的16S rRNA基因测序，废水施用使细菌α多样性降低19%（p < 0.001），并重塑群落结构，富营养型Proteobacteria、Bacteroidetes和Firmicutes扩张，而寡营养型Acidobacteria、Chloroflexi、Verrucomicrobia和Planctomycetes减少；土壤pH、总氮和有效磷是群落差异的主要驱动因子（Mantel r分别为0.57、0.52和0.49，p < 0.001）。研究表明，鲶鱼废水施用为酸性热带土壤带来短期肥力提升，但以微生物多样性降低为代价，呈现肥力-多样性权衡，为撒哈拉以南非洲城郊水产-农业一体化的

papers.title: Synergistic antifouling coating based on PS-b-PDMS/CaO2 for marine aquaculture nets
papers.authors: Li, Zhu; Sun, Ningxin; Li, Shiwei; Yang, Jiaao; Guo, Yi; Dong, Lijie
papers.summary_cn: 基于PS-b-PDMS/CaO2的协同防污涂层用于海水养殖网箱，旨在解决生物污损问题。该研究通过结合聚合物与CaO2的协同作用，提升涂层防污性能及耐久性。适用于渔业设施维护，减少清洗频率与生态影响。

papers.title: Growth models for farmed post-smolt to adult salmonids: a systematic review for Atlantic salmon aquaculture under warming and salmon-lice pressure
papers.authors: Kleiven, Stian K.; Abdel-Fattah, Dina; Bøhn, Thomas
papers.abstract: Rising sea surface temperatures and salmon lice ( Lepeophtheirus salmonis ) are interacting environmental and health pressures that can affect growth, condition, survival, treatment needs, and production outcomes in farmed Atlantic salmon ( Salmo salar ). This systematic review evaluated growth models used in farmed salmonid aquaculture to identify frameworks suitable for quantifying the combined effects of temperature and salmon lice burden during the post-smolt to adult production phase. We initially screened salmonid growth-model studies broadly, including farmed and wild systems, but excluded wild salmonid models from the final synthesis because their ecological objectives, feeding assumptions, data structures, and outputs were poorly aligned with farm-level aquaculture scenario modeling. The retained farmed-salmonid models included empirical index and phenomenological models, bioenergetic models, and nutritional models. Empirical approaches such as Thermal-unit Growth Coefficient and logistic growth models require relatively few inputs and are practical for farm-level scenario analysis, but their transferability depends on local calibration and validation. Mechanistic bioenergetic and nutritional models provide greater biological realism and can represent stressor effects more explicitly, but require substantially more parameters and higher-resolution data. Explicit coupling of salmon growth with salmon-lice dynamics remains rare. For scenario-oriented assessment of warming and salmon lice in Atlantic salmon aquaculture, the most practical near-term framework is a validated, temperature-driven farmed-salmon growth model that is locally calibrated with production and environmental data and coupled modularly to a lice-dynamics or infestation-pressure component.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统评估了养殖大西洋鲑（Salmo salar）从post-smolt到成鱼阶段使用的生长模型，旨在筛选能量化海水升温与鲑鱼虱（Lepeophtheirus salmonis）复合压力的建模框架。通过筛选养殖与野生鲑科模型，最终保留经验指数、表观模型、生物能量学及营养模型，其中经验方法（如热单位生长系数、逻辑斯蒂模型）输入少、实用性强，但依赖本地校准；机制模型生物真实性高，却需更多参数。目前鲜有模型显式耦合生长与虱动态，建议近期采用经本地生产环境数据验证的温度驱动生长模型，并模块化连接虱侵染压力组件，以支持情景评估。

papers.title: The effect of stabilizing fish additives on the textural and organoleptic properties of chocolate mousses
papers.authors: Vorobev, V. I.; Chernega, O. P.; Lents, K. E.
papers.abstract: The relevance of the study is due to the potential for the industrial use of a significant amount of by-product raw material – fish skin – for the production of fish collagen hydrate, which is used as a texture stabilizer in chocolate mousses. The aim of the study is to evaluate the effect of fish collagen and gelatin additives, used as stabilizers, on the textural and organoleptic properties of the resulting chocolate mousses. The nutritional value of the studied fish stabilizing additives (collagen and gelatin), as well as beef gelatin, is demonstrated. The density of chocolate mousse samples has been determined: 0,849 g/cm 3 for those with beef gelatin, 0,827 g/cm 3 for those with fish collagen, and 0,756 g/cm 3 for those with fish gelatin. The texture parameters for chilled and defrosted mousses with fish collagen and gelatin are presented, respectively: for chilled ones – hardness (2,00±0,49 N and 1,38±0,42 N), adhesiveness (2,8±0,40 mJ and 2,40±0,40 mJ), cohesivity (0,84±0,14 and 0,74±0,21), elasticity (0,41±0,14 and 0,30±1,12), springiness (3,33±0,56 mm and 2,16±1,47 mm), chewiness (4,90±0,40 mJ and 2,10±1,20 mJ), average peak load (1,83±0,56 N and 1,26±0,14 N); for defrosted ones – hardness (3,16± 0,70 N and 1,47±0,14 N), adhesiveness (2,67±1,45 mJ and 1,70±0,70 mJ), cohesivity (0,77±0,21 and 0,72±0,35), elasticity (0,42±0,14 and 0,22±0,42), resilience (4,00± 0,35 mm and 2,49±0,70 mm), chewiness (8,33±1,20 mJ and 2,60±2,0 mJ), average peak load (2,91±0,63 N and 1.26±0,14 N). An organoleptic assessment of chocolate mousse samples using stabilizing fish additives is given, and options for their use in the production of dessert products are proposed.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了利用鱼皮副产物制备的鱼胶原蛋白及鱼明胶作为稳定剂，对巧克力慕斯质构和感官特性的影响。通过对比鱼胶原、鱼明胶与牛明胶，测定了慕斯密度及冷藏/解冻状态下的质构参数（如硬度、黏附性、弹性等），并进行了感官评价。结果显示，鱼胶原和鱼明胶可有效替代牛明胶，其中鱼明胶慕斯密度最低（0.756 g/cm³），且不同稳定剂对质构特性影响显著。研究为鱼类副产物在甜点工业中的应用提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Edible Fungi in Functional Aquafeeds: Prebiotic and Immunostimulatory Effects in Commercially Important Farmed Fish
papers.authors: Valdés, Marco; Quiñones, John; Cortes, Matias; Huaiquipán, Rodrigo; Martínez, Ailín; Paz, Erwin A.; Sepúlveda, Néstor; Díaz, Rommy
papers.abstract: Aquaculture faces structural constraints linked to input sustainability, animal health, and a persistent reliance on fishmeal and fish oil, alongside the intensive use of antibiotics in high-density production systems. In this context, edible fungi have emerged as promising functional ingredients, primarily due to their content of structural polysaccharides, particularly β-glucans and chitin. This review synthesizes recent evidence on the dietary inclusion of fungal-derived compounds in aquafeeds for commercially relevant species. Overall, these bioactive components have been associated with beneficial effects on growth performance, feed efficiency, antioxidant status, and disease resistance in species such as Oncorhynchus mykiss, Salmo salar, and Oreochromis spp. However, the magnitude and consistency of these responses remain highly variable across studies. Such variability is primarily attributed to differences in the structural composition of the ingredients, their physicochemical form, processing methods, and their compatibility with host digestive physiology, all of which influence functional bioavailability and the resulting biological responses. Consequently, their biological effects are context-dependent and should be interpreted according to ingredient characteristics, host species, dietary inclusion level, and experimental conditions rather than assuming a universal dose–response relationship. Effective implementation will require advances in matrix standardization, detailed structural characterization of bioactive compounds, and validation under industry-relevant conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究综述了食用真菌作为功能性饲料原料在水产养殖中的应用潜力，重点探讨其结构多糖（尤其是β-葡聚糖和几丁质）对虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）、大西洋鲑（Salmo salar）和罗非鱼（Oreochromis spp.）等经济鱼类的益生元及免疫刺激作用。结果表明，膳食添加真菌源化合物可改善生长性能、饲料效率、抗氧化状态和抗病力，但效应大小和一致性因研究而异，主要受原料结构组成、理化形式、加工方法及宿主消化生理兼容性影响。综述强调，真菌活性成分的生物学效应具有情境依赖性，需结合原料特性、宿主种类、添加水平和实验条件综合评估，而非假设普遍剂量-反应关系；未来应用需推进基质标准化、活性化合物结构表征及产业条件验证。

papers.title: Contrasting Food Web Dynamics Across Oceanographic Boundaries in Subarctic Pelagic Ecosystems
papers.authors: Troina, Genyffer C.; Pakhomov, Evgeny A.; Weitkamp, Laurie; Hunt, Brian P. V.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Understanding the structure of pelagic food webs across multiple trophic levels is critical for elucidating species interactions, energy flow, and anthropogenic impacts on production. This study presents a comprehensive analysis of the eastern North Pacific pelagic food webs, focusing on the Gulf of Alaska (GoA) during late winter of 2019. We demonstrate that oceanographic boundaries within the GoA delineate distinct ecological provinces, with potential implications for fisheries management and climate change responses. Analyzing stable isotopes in plankton, micronekton, and nekton—including five Pacific salmon species, other pelagic fishes, and cephalopods—we found pronounced differences in food web structure between the northwest (NW‐GoA) and southeast (SE‐GoA) regions. In the low‐nutrient, picoplankton‐dominated SE‐GoA, there was greater trophic niche overlap among gelatinous organisms, micronekton, and nekton, suggesting a more interconnected and trophically diverse food web. Temperature and nutrients emerged as important predictors of small zooplankton biomass, highlighting the role of bottom‐up processes in shaping community structure. Additionally, the high nekton/micronekton biomass contrasted with the low macrozooplankton biomass, consistent with top‐down control by upper trophic levels. In contrast, the nutrient‐rich, diatom‐dominated NW‐GoA exhibited higher macrozooplankton biomass, particularly euphausiids, supporting a “wasp‐waist” food web structure with lower trophic diversity. The high biomass and distinct isotope niches of gelatinous organisms in this region suggested a separate trophic pathway, potentially sustained by a prominent microbial food web. These regional differences suggest that climate‐driven changes in oceanographic conditions may reshape species interactions and energy transfer pathways, with important consequences for ecosystem functioning and the productivity of higher trophic levels, including Pacific salmon.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究分析了2019年冬季阿拉斯加湾（GoA）亚北极浮游生态系统的食物网结构，利用稳定同位素技术测定了浮游生物、微型游泳动物及游泳动物（包括五种太平洋鲑鱼）的营养关系。结果显示，西北GoA（富营养、硅藻主导）呈现“黄蜂腰”食物网结构，大型浮游动物（如磷虾）生物量高，而东南GoA（贫营养、微微型浮游植物主导）营养生态位重叠度更高，食物网更互联且多样。温度和营养盐是小型浮游动物生物量的关键预测因子，表明bottom-up过程调控群落结构，同时高游泳动物/微型游泳动物生物量与低大型浮游动物生物量并存，提示上层营养级的top-down控制。这些跨海洋学边界的差异暗示，气候驱动的环境变化可能重塑物种互作和能量传递路径，对生态系统功能及太平洋鲑鱼等上层生物生产力具有重要影响。

papers.title: Sidney Opiyo: Bringing Fisheries Science Home
papers.authors: Scharping, Nathaniel
papers.abstract: The environmental scientist hopes to return to his home island in Kenya, as both scientist and photographer.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究聚焦肯尼亚环境科学家Sidney Opiyo的职业愿景，旨在以科学家和摄影师双重身份回归家乡岛屿。摘要未提供具体研究方法或数据，仅概述其个人目标，即结合科研与影像记录推动本土渔业科学传播。内容侧重人物叙事，缺乏渔业科学实证细节，但涉及渔业科学应用场景。

papers.title: End-to-end modeling for the Ross Sea Region Marine Protected Area: a review of available tools for conservation objectives
papers.authors: Lovvorn, James R.; Nissen, Cara; Bahl, Alexis A.; Behrens, Erik; Brooks, Cassandra M.; Christensen, Katy; Dinniman, Michael S.; Dove, Lilian A.; DuVivier, Alice K.; Hofmann, Eileen E.
papers.abstract: The challenge of protecting marine ecosystems, including biodiversity and manifold interactions in changing environments, has encouraged development of end-to-end models linking physical drivers through entire food webs to upper-level predators. Ideally such models should have temporal and spatial resolution adequate to capture important small-scale processes, while including scales large enough to encompass local food webs and movements of wide-ranging consumers. The need for component submodels to be manipulated and upgraded independently by scientists from different disciplines, and used selectively depending on questions addressed, favors modular structure allowing linkage of different submodels with varying strengths and weaknesses. As an example, this paper reviews modeling tools available, developments needed, and proposed integrative strategies to construct end-to-end models for the Ross Sea Region Marine Protected Area (MPA). Decisions there are especially needed on how to preserve biodiversity and ecosystem structure and function under potential fishing scenarios in the face of climate change. We find that Earth System Models currently lack adequate spatial resolution to address key management issues in the Ross Sea, whereas regional-scale physical models are available to drive biogeochemical models at scales of a few kilometers. Models of local food webs can be run concurrently in contiguous spatial cells with between-cell exchange of organisms and materials. Individual-based models that incorporate acoustic measures of the preyscape can account for dependence of upper-level predators on the patch structure of prey within food web cells. For the Ross Sea MPA, innovations important for developing end-to-end models include (1) accounting for differences between diatoms and Phaeocystis as the main primary producers, (2) incorporating the roles of sea ice and associated biota in pelagic processes, (3) considering the importance of benthic-pelagic coupling to food webs including species whose life stages span the water column, and (4) linking predator foraging on patches at scales of tens of meters to food webs at scales of multiple kilometers. Geographic Information Systems (GIS) have been advocated as common platforms to integrate observational data or submodel outputs into end-to-end simulations in a spatially explicit format. Such an approach would facilitate facultative use of different submodel types depending on the ecological and management questions of interest.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究综述了罗斯海区域海洋保护区（MPA）的端到端建模工具，旨在评估现有方法在实现保护目标中的适用性。通过分析物理驱动、食物网及顶级捕食者模型的整合策略，发现地球系统模型分辨率不足，而区域物理模型可驱动公里级生物地球化学模拟。关键创新包括区分硅藻与棕囊藻初级生产、纳入海冰生态、底栖-浮游耦合及捕食者斑块觅食机制，并建议以GIS为平台集成多子模型。研究强调模块化结构可灵活应对气候变化与潜在捕捞情景下的生物多样性保护决策。

papers.title: Multiscale Environmental Forcing of Multispecies Fishery Dynamics Across Climate Timescales
papers.authors: Compaire, Jesus C.; Irigoyen, Alejo J.; Simionato, Claudia G.; Acha, E. Marcelo
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Fisheries management often relies on single‐species assessments, overlooking multispecies dynamics while facing the added challenge of nonlinear environmental variability. Marine landings of most commercially exploited species in the Southwestern Atlantic have declined for decades and are projected to decrease further under climate change, as ocean warming is expected to reduce fisheries catches and revenues. Despite these trends, multispecies studies linking regional landings to environmental forcing remain scarce. Addressing this gap, we propose an integrated approach to examine multiscale environmental influence on fisheries landings within the Argentinean–Uruguayan Common Fishing Zone, a complex hydrographic region strongly influenced by the Río de la Plata discharge. We applied time‐series alignment and latent factor modeling to identify common patterns across multivariate landing series. These patterns served as response variables in lagged generalized linear and additive models, incorporating as predictors: riverine runoff, sea surface temperature, salinity, and turbidity, wind mixing, and large‐scale climatic indices such as the El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO), the Southern Annular Mode (SAM), and the Southern Oscillation Index (SOI). Time‐lagged analyses show that environmental forcing at local and basin scales explains much landings variability. Turbidity and salinity were the most consistently retained variables, while the best‐fitting model (82% deviance explained) incorporated the combined effects of SAM and turbidity. Our findings demonstrate that diverse fisheries landings can be summarized into common multivariate patterns, which in turn can be linked to multiscale environmental forcing. This provides a robust basis for climate‐informed management, supporting a transition from isolated single‐species assessments to integrated multispecies frameworks.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对西南大西洋阿根廷-乌拉圭共同捕捞区，提出整合时间序列对齐与潜在因子模型的方法，分析多尺度环境强迫对多物种渔业捕捞量的影响。研究发现，浊度和盐度是最稳定的环境预测变量，而结合南方环状模（SAM）与浊度的最优模型解释了82%的捕捞量变异。结果表明，多物种捕捞量可归纳为共同模式，并与局地及流域尺度环境强迫显著关联，为从单物种评估转向气候信息支持的多物种管理框架提供了依据。

papers.title: Dissolved oxygen levels differentially regulate ammonia metabolism plasticity in mandarin fish (Siniperca chuatsi)
papers.authors: Li, Hongyan; Xu, Jiaqi; Wang, Guangjun; Li, Zhifei; Zhang, Kai; Tian, Jingjing; Xia, Yun; Xie, Wenping; Zhong, Quanfa; Xie, Jun
papers.abstract: Dissolved oxygen (DO) is a key environmental factor affecting fish metabolism, yet its regulatory role in ammonia production, conversion, and excretion remains poorly understood. This study investigated how DO levels modulate ammonia metabolism plasticity in mandarin fish ( Siniperca chuatsi ) as a potential biological strategy for mitigating aquaculture-derived ammonia pollution. Fish were exposed to normoxia (6.05 ± 0.17 mg/L), hypoxia (2.67 ± 0.25 mg/L), or hyperoxia (9.73 ± 0.62 mg/L) for 48 h. Results showed that hypoxia caused oxidative stress, as evidenced by elevated MDA levels, suppressed SOD and CAT activities, and obvious tissue damage to the livers and gills of S. chuatsi . In response to this stress, both hypoxia and hyperoxia enhanced the antioxidant capacity of S. chuatsi via the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway. Compared to the normoxia and hyperoxia groups, the ammonia excretion rate was significantly lower in the hypoxia group. Distinct adaptive strategies in ammonia homeostasis were observed under different DO conditions. Under hypoxic condition, S. chuatsi downregulated hepatic glutamate dehydrogenase ( gdh ) to reduce ammonia production, upregulated carbamyl phosphate synthase 1 ( cps1 ) to promote ammonia conversion to urea, and upregulated RH glycoproteins and Na + /H + exchanger 3 ( nhe3 ) as a compensatory response, ultimately leading to a 24.06% reduction in water NH 4 + -N accumulation at 48 h. In contrast, hyperoxia reduced ammonia production and increased urea conversion but did not enhance excretion. Instead, it improved ammonia tolerance in S. chuatsi . In summary, hypoxia reduced net ammonia excretion via integrated adjustments in production, conversion, and excretion, whereas hyperoxia enhanced ammonia tolerance without altering excretion. This DO-mediated metabolic plasticity provides a biological strategy for mitigating aquaculture-derived ammonia pollution by utilizing existing aeration to harness intrinsic fish physiology, supporting the development of sustainable aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了溶解氧（DO）水平对鳜（Siniperca chuatsi）氨代谢可塑性的调控作用，旨在为减轻水产养殖氨污染提供生物学策略。通过将鱼暴露于常氧（6.05 mg/L）、低氧（2.67 mg/L）和高氧（9.73 mg/L）条件下48小时，发现低氧诱导氧化应激（MDA升高、SOD和CAT活性抑制及肝鳃组织损伤），而低氧和高氧均通过Nrf2/Keap1通路增强抗氧化能力。低氧组氨排泄率显著低于常氧和高氧组，其通过下调肝脏谷氨酸脱氢酶（gdh）减少氨生成、上调氨甲酰磷酸合成酶1（cps1）促进氨转化为尿素，并上调RH糖蛋白和Na+/H+交换体3（nhe3）作为补偿机制，最终使水体NH4+-N积累降低24.06%。相比之下，高氧减少氨生成并增加尿素转化，但不增强排泄，而是提高氨耐受性。该DO介导的代谢可塑性为利用现有增氧设施调控鱼类生理以缓解养殖氨污染提供了新思路。

papers.title: Environmental footprints for wild and cultivated fish: A comparative analysis using environmentally extended input-output modeling
papers.authors: Salminen, Jani; Savolainen, Hannu; Haahti, Joanna; Heikkinen, Mari; Meriläinen, Teemu; Virkkunen, Henri
papers.abstract: Abstract This paper examines the applicability of environmentally extended input-output (EE-IO) modeling, first, to generate coherent carbon, phosphorus, nitrogen and water footprints for a broad set of wild and cultivated fish. Second, the study compares conventional and recirculating aquaculture systems' environmental performance. Third, it examines how changes in fish feed composition influence the environmental footprints of cultivated fish. Carbon footprints for wild fish generally ranged from 0.2 to 2.0 kg CO 2 -eq kg -1 . For rainbow trout from conventional and recirculating aquaculture, these values are 2.5 and 8.3 kg CO 2 -eq kg -1 , respectively. Respective P footprints for cultivated rainbow trout were 1.3 kg and -0.9 CO 2 -eq kg -1 . Replacement of fish meal and oil made of regional wild fish with agricultural ingredients increases the nutrient footprints of cultivated fish. This study demonstrates that EE-IO modeling is well suited to highly disaggregated footprint calculations and versatile analyses in the context of fisheries and aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究采用环境扩展投入产出（EE-IO）模型，系统比较了野生与养殖鱼类的碳、磷、氮和水足迹，并评估了传统与循环水养殖系统的环境绩效。结果显示，野生鱼类的碳足迹为0.2–2.0 kg CO₂-eq kg⁻¹，而传统和循环水养殖的虹鳟分别为2.5和8.3 kg CO₂-eq kg⁻¹，且用农业原料替代区域野生鱼粉鱼油会增加养殖鱼类的营养足迹。研究表明，EE-IO模型适用于渔业和水产养殖中高度细分的足迹计算及多维度分析。

papers.title: Engineering monosex and sterile fish for food production: from conventional methods to CRISPR-based precision
papers.authors: Min, Yue; Sun, Fei; Wong, Joey; Lee, May; Yue, Gen Hua
papers.abstract: Abstract Monosex and sterile fish populations are increasingly recognized as essential tools for enhancing aquaculture productivity while safeguarding ecosystems from genetic introgression and uncontrolled reproduction. Conventional approaches such as hormonal manipulation and triploidy have demonstrated utility but face persistent limitations in efficiency, welfare, and regulatory acceptance. Recent breakthroughs in CRISPR-based genome editing and germ cell transplantation now enable heritable, scalable, and biocontained control of sex and fertility, offering transformative potential for sustainable aquaculture. This paper synthesizes advances across finfish and crustaceans, critically evaluates technical and regulatory bottlenecks, and highlights convergent solutions integrating automation, artificial intelligence, and governance frameworks. By positioning reproductive programming as a cornerstone of climate-resilient and sustainable aquatic food systems, we propose a roadmap toward commercial adoption that balances biological precision, ecological safety, and societal acceptance.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究综述了单性及不育鱼类在提升水产养殖效率与生态安全中的关键作用，比较了传统激素处理和三倍体技术与基于CRISPR的基因编辑及生殖细胞移植等新型方法的优劣。文章指出，CRISPR技术可实现可遗传、可扩展且生物封闭的性别与育性控制，但面临效率、福利和监管瓶颈。作者提出整合自动化、人工智能和治理框架的解决方案，并规划了从实验室到商业应用的路线图，以推动气候适应性可持续水产食品系统的发展。

papers.title: Limited Success of Spat Ropes and Rubber Ramps for Restoring Fish Passage at a Perched Culvert
papers.authors: Bowie, Sjaan; Boddy, Nixie; Baker, Cindy F.; Horrox, Jonny; Franklin, Paul A.
papers.journal: New Zealand Journal of Marine and Freshwater Research
papers.abstract: Many culverts in New Zealand rivers are poorly designed or maintained, impeding fish migrations. This study tested three low‐cost fish passage solutions—mussel spat ropes, a flexible rubber ramp, and a combination of both—at a perched culvert apron on the West Coast. Passage efficiency was assessed for three indicator species with different locomotive capabilities: īnanga ( Galaxias maculatus ), redfin bully ( Gobiomorphus huttoni ), and banded kōkopu ( Galaxias fasciatus ). Spat rope and rubber ramp both independently and in combination were ineffective at facilitating passage of īnanga or redfin bully. The combination of spat rope and rubber ramp moderately increased banded kōkopu passage, predominantly for fish <50 mm total length, but individually offered little benefit. The tested ‘solutions’ are unsuitable for non‐climbing species and, when deployed in combination, showed limited benefits that diminish rapidly with fish size for a species with strong climbing abilities. As such, there are few contexts where these solutions will be appropriate for restoring fish passage for all the species and size classes present.
papers.summary_cn: 新西兰许多河流中的涵洞因设计或维护不当而阻碍鱼类洄游。本研究在西海岸一处悬空涵洞测试了三种低成本过鱼方案——贻贝采苗绳、柔性橡胶坡道及两者组合，针对三种不同运动能力的指示鱼类（īnanga、redfin bully 和 banded kōkopu）评估其通过效率。结果显示，采苗绳和橡胶坡道单独或组合使用均无法有效帮助 īnanga 和 redfin bully 通过；组合方案仅对体长<50 mm 的 banded kōkopu 有中等提升效果，且随鱼体增大效益迅速下降。这些方案对非攀爬鱼类不适用，组合使用时对攀爬能力强的物种也仅提供有限且尺寸依赖的益处，因此在实际应用中难以满足恢复所有鱼类物种和规格通过的需求。

papers.title: Seasonal variation of liver and muscle mercury across two populations of a freshwater sport fish
papers.authors: Pereira, Sofia C; Fernandes, Timothy J; Covernton, Garth A; Lehnherr, Igor; Branfireun, Brian; Varty, Stephanie; Luu, Taylor; Jama, Faduma; McMeans, Bailey C
papers.journal: Transactions of the American Fisheries Society
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective North-temperate fishes fluctuate in their energy status, metabolic rate, and behavior in response to seasonal changes in temperature and light, which could influence tissue concentrations of biomagnifying contaminants like mercury (Hg). Yet, repeated sampling within a single year is rarely conducted to quantify if contaminant concentrations vary seasonally across different fish populations. Methods We quantified liver total Hg (THg), muscle THg, and liver methylmercury of Lake Trout Salvelinus namaycush, a predatory fish that is harvested for sport and subsistence, from two different lakes in Ontario (Lake of Two Rivers and Lake Opeongo) across all four seasons over two consecutive years. Seasonal increases in Hg were expected to occur during fall, due to decreased Lake Trout energy status following fall spawning, and winter, due to increased winter trophic positions or temperature-driven decreases in elimination rates. Results Contrary to our expectations, liver Hg varied seasonally in only one of our study lakes (Lake Opeongo). In this lake, liver THg increased from summer to fall, but only in year 1, and liver methylmercury decreased from fall to winter. Also contrary to our expectations, muscle THg displayed more consistent seasonal patterns and achieved the lowest concentrations in summer in both lakes and years, which could relate to growth dilution. Muscle THg increased by 32% from summer to fall in Lake Opeongo (from 2.078 ± 0.094 to 2.75 ± 0.145 μg/g) and by 55% from summer to winter in Lake of Two Rivers (from 2.054 ± 0.09 to 3.198 ± 0.216 μg/g), which could relate to lower body condition after fall spawning (Lake Opeongo) and higher winter trophic positions (Lake of Two Rivers). Conclusions Inconsistent seasonal variation in liver Hg could arise because of dynamic processes of Hg accumulation and redistribution occurring in the liver. However, muscle tissue, which can be sampled nonlethally, could be useful for monitoring seasonal Hg trends based on our findings. Because muscle THg was lower in summer compared with fall and winter, fish Hg samples collected during summer alone may not reflect Hg concentrations during other seasons.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了安大略省两个湖泊（Lake of Two Rivers 和 Lake Opeongo）中湖鳟（Salvelinus namaycush）肝脏和肌肉总汞（THg）及肝脏甲基汞的季节性变化，连续两年覆盖四季采样。结果显示，肝脏汞仅在 Lake Opeongo 中呈现季节性波动（夏季至秋季升高，但仅在第一年），而肌肉汞在两地均呈一致模式，夏季浓度最低，秋季和冬季分别升高32%和55%，可能与生长稀释及繁殖后体况下降或冬季营养级升高有关。研究表明，肌肉组织可作为非致死性监测汞季节性变化的有效指标，但夏季单次采样可能低估其他季节的汞暴露水平。

papers.title: Multi-horizon forecasting of coastal high water temperature events for operational marine-heatwave early warning in South Korean aquaculture: a walk-forward benchmark of eleven statistical and deep-learning models
papers.authors: Kang, Young-Jin; Kim, Ki-Hwan; Jeong, Seok Chan
papers.abstract: Introduction High water temperature (HWT) marine-heatwave events along the southern coast of South Korea cause repeated mass mortalities in cage aquaculture of olive flounder (Paralichthys olivaceus), rock bream (Oplegnathus fasciatus), red sea bream (Pagrus major) and Korean rockfish (Sebastes schlegelii). Existing operational forecasts rely on coarse numerical ocean models that lack the temporal granularity and site specificity required by farm managers, while the recent wave of deep-learning sea surface temperature (SST) models has been tuned almost exclusively on smoother open-ocean grids. Methods We present the Hybrid GNN-BiLSTM, a 3.1 M-parameter graph–temporal architecture combining a weighted spatial GNN with a BiLSTM temporal core, reversible instance normalization (RevIN) and a persistence skip connection, and benchmark it against ten alternatives – three reference baselines (Persistence, Seasonal-naïve, Climatology), the ARIMAX statistical model, four lightweight or linear deep models (DLinear, PatchTST, N-HiTS, CNN-LSTM) and two attention-based models (Informer, Temporal Fusion Transformer) – on a five-year hourly insitu panel from 30 monitoring stations along the Tongyeong–Geoje–Yeosu coast (2020–2025) under a unified rolling-origin walk-forward protocol (720 h lookback, 168 h horizon, one forecast per station every 24 h across a 12-month validation window). Marine-heatwave detection is scored at tiered 26/28/30 °C operational thresholds. Results The Hybrid GNN-BiLSTM achieves the lowest 1 h RMSE (0.057 °C), 0.85 °C at h = 72 and 1.24 °C at h = 168, with the highest long-horizon residual skill of any deep model on this panel (SS_res = 0.71 at h = 72). CNNLSTM attains the lowest mean horizon root-mean-square error (RMSE = 0.636 °C) thanks to a nearly flat error curve, and PatchTST is competitive at short-to-medium horizons (0.694 °C mean). The Hybrid GNN-BiLSTM reaches F1 = 0.82 at 26 °C and F1 = 0.65 at 28 °C, and a probabilistic Gaussian negative-log-likelihood head supplies calibrated 90 % prediction intervals without post-hoc recalibration. Discussion A 38 h mean advisory lead time was demonstrated in the 2024 NIFS regional HWT alert period, indicating that a site-specific graph–temporal model can deliver operationally actionable early warning for coastal aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对韩国南部沿海养殖区高温热浪事件，提出了一种混合GNN-BiLSTM模型（310万参数），结合加权空间图神经网络与双向LSTM时序核心，并引入RevIN归一化和持久性跳跃连接。基于2020-2025年统营-巨济-丽水海岸30个监测站的小时级数据，在统一滚动起点前向验证协议下（720小时回溯、168小时预测），与十种基准模型（含统计模型ARIMAX、深度模型DLinear、PatchTST等）对比。结果显示，混合模型在1小时RMSE最低（0.057°C），72小时达0.85°C，168小时为1.24°C，且在26°C和28°C阈值下F1分数分别达0.82和0.65，并输出校准的90%预测区间。2024年NIFS区域高温警报期间实现38小时平均预警提前量，表明该站点特定图-时序模型可为沿海 aquaculture 提供可操作早期预警。

papers.title: Genome Characterization and Biocontrol Potential of a Novel Bacteriophage PP24 Against Vibrio parahaemolyticus in Shrimp Aquaculture
papers.authors: Fu, Jingyun; Tang, Wei; Li, Ying; Xu, Zhongfa; He, Zengguo
papers.journal: Journal of Ocean University of China
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对虾类养殖中严重危害的副溶血性弧菌（Vibrio parahaemolyticus），分离并鉴定了一株新型噬菌体PP24，对其基因组进行了全面表征。通过基因组分析揭示了该噬菌体的分类地位、裂解性特征及关键功能基因，并评估了其作为生物防控剂的潜力。结果表明，PP24具有宿主特异性强、裂解效率高的特点，在虾类养殖环境中展现出良好的生物防治应用前景。

papers.title: The microbiome bottleneck in seahorse aquaculture: a conceptual framework linking biofilm ecology, probiotics and larval survival
papers.authors: Wen, Jinxi; Yao, Yuan; Hu, Xirun; Li, Renruichen; Tan, Zhenyuan; Zhang, Tongze; Briandet, Romain; Habimana, Olivier
papers.summary_cn: 海马养殖中的微生物组瓶颈：提出一个概念框架，整合生物膜生态学、益生菌干预与幼体存活率，旨在解析养殖系统中微生物动态对海马育苗成败的关键作用。该框架强调生物膜作为病原菌或有益菌载体的生态角色，并探讨益生菌调控微生物组以提升幼体健康与存活率的潜在路径。

papers.title: The Impact of Hormonal Utilization in Aquaculture on Growth and Reproduction: A Review
papers.authors: Nirmalkar, Doman; Damle, Dushyant Kumar; Lal, Jham; Markam, Amisha; Thakur, Vivek Kumar; Painkra, Ambika; Mondal, Reeya; Sahu, Vijaylaxmi; Dhruv, Hema; Sahu, Komal
papers.journal: Journal of Scientific Research and Reports
papers.abstract: Aquaculture, the farming of fish and other aquatic organisms for food, is one of the world's most rapidly expanding food-production sectors and provides substantial economic benefits at national and regional levels. India is a major contributor to global fisheries and aquaculture production. Growing demand for seafood and increased per-capita fish consumption have accelerated the expansion of aquaculture. Hormones are central to the regulation of fish growth, development, reproduction, and metabolism. Somatotropin, gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH), thyroid hormones, steroids, prostaglandins, gonadotropins, and GnRH analogues are used to enhance production, regulate development, and induce maturation and spawning. Hypophysation and other induced-breeding methods rely on natural or synthetic hormonal preparations to improve reproductive success. These techniques have increased the efficiency and profitability of fish farming. Nevertheless, hormone use in aquaculture raises concerns regarding food safety, human health, and environmental effects. Excessive use or improper disposal may introduce hormonal residues into aquatic ecosystems and water supplies, potentially affecting fish fertility, sex ratios, and endocrine function. Residues in farmed fish may also create concerns for consumers. Therefore, although hormonal applications can improve growth and reproductive management, their use requires careful dosing, monitoring, and responsible disposal. Aquaculture development should balance production requirements with the protection of environmental and public health by promoting safer, controlled, and more sustainable hormonal practices.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述探讨了激素在水产养殖中的应用及其对生长和繁殖的影响。印度作为全球渔业和水产养殖的主要贡献者，激素（如生长激素、GnRH、甲状腺激素、类固醇等）被广泛用于促进生长、诱导成熟和产卵，显著提高了养殖效率和经济效益。然而，激素的过度使用或不当处理可能导致残留物进入水生态系统，影响鱼类生育力、性别比例和内分泌功能，并引发食品安全和人类健康担忧。文章强调，激素应用需谨慎控制剂量、加强监测和负责任处置，以在增产需求与环境和公共卫生保护之间取得平衡，推动更安全、可持续的激素使用实践。

papers.title: Shiga Toxin-Producing Escherichia coli in Aquaculture: A Decade (2015–2025)-Long Global Retrospective Outlook
papers.authors: Sarwar, Ayesha; Aslam, Bilal; Aljasir, Sulaiman F.
papers.abstract: Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli (STEC) contamination and proliferation in aquaculture and aquatic systems is worrisome for global food safety, as well as veterinary and public health. Traditionally linked with terrestrial ruminant reservoirs, aquaculture matrices, including farmed finfish, shellfish, culture water, and benthic organisms, are increasingly acknowledged as potential conduits for the dissemination of STEC. Herein, the review documented data concerning the prevalence, genomic composition, and ecological dynamics of STEC across various aquaculture environments across different regions of the globe. As a result, the persistence of virulence-associated genes (VAGs) and antibiotic-resistant genes (ARGs) in STEC within the aquaculture supply chain presents a considerable risk to global food security and public health, highlighting the urgent necessity for comprehensive “One Health” surveillance frameworks aimed at alleviating aquatic biosecurity challenges.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究回顾了2015–2025年间水产养殖系统中产志贺毒素大肠杆菌（STEC）的污染状况，涵盖全球不同区域的养殖鱼类、贝类、养殖水体和底栖生物。通过分析STEC的流行率、基因组组成及生态动态，发现其毒力相关基因（VAGs）和抗生素抗性基因（ARGs）在水产供应链中持续存在，对全球食品安全和公共卫生构成显著威胁。研究强调亟需建立综合性的“One Health”监测框架，以应对水生生物安全挑战。

papers.title: Assessment of water prophylaxis and biosafety in finfish aquaculture - current and emerging technologies
papers.authors: Bartkova, Simona; Valentino, Francesco; Saraiva, Marcia; Duman, Muhammed; Gerilovych, Anton; Radosavljevic, Vladimir; de Marco, Ario; Saticioglu, Izzet Burcin; Ay, Hilal
papers.abstract: Effective water quality management is a fundamental component of disease prevention, fish welfare, and sustainable production in finfish aquaculture. As aquaculture continues to expand to meet increasing global food demand, maintaining biosafe aquatic environments has become increasingly challenging due to production intensification, climate change, emerging pathogens, and the spread of antimicrobial resistance. While conventional approaches such as mechanical filtration, biofiltration, ultraviolet disinfection, ozonation, and water exchange remain central to water prophylaxis, increasing attention is being directed toward technologies that support earlier pathogen detection, improved risk assessment, and more targeted intervention strategies. This review examines water prophylaxis and biosafety through an integrated framework that links water quality, microbial ecology, pathogen surveillance, antimicrobial resistance, and preventive interventions. First, the biological and environmental mechanisms through which water quality influences disease susceptibility, microbiome stability, pathogen persistence, and antimicrobial resistance are evaluated. Conventional water-treatment technologies are then assessed alongside emerging approaches, including environmental DNA/environmental RNA monitoring, probiotics, phage therapy, biosensors, smart sensors, microfluidic platforms, and droplet-based molecular diagnostics. Emphasis is placed on their practical applicability, technological readiness, and suitability for different finfish production systems. The review highlights that effective biosafety management depends increasingly on integrating environmental monitoring with molecular diagnostics, risk assessment, and targeted interventions rather than relying solely on water-quality control or reactive disease treatment. Emerging technologies differ substantially in readiness, ranging from established and pilot-stage approaches to experimental technologies that require further validation before routine implementation. To support practical decision-making, the review synthesizes these technologies within an integrated water-prophylaxis and biosafety framework that links monitoring, diagnostics, risk assessment, intervention strategies, and reassessment pathways. Overall, sustainable finfish aquaculture will depend on combining conventional water-treatment infrastructure with advanced surveillance technologies and preventive biological interventions within coordinated biosafety programs. Such integration offers considerable potential to improve fish health, reduce environmental impacts, support responsible antimicrobial use, and enhance the long-term resilience of aquaculture production systems.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统评估了有鳍鱼类养殖中水质预防与生物安全管理的综合框架，涵盖从传统机械过滤、生物过滤、紫外消毒到新兴的环境DNA/RNA监测、益生菌、噬菌体疗法及分子诊断技术。研究发现，有效生物安全日益依赖环境监测与分子诊断、风险评估和靶向干预的整合，而非单纯依赖水质控制或被动疾病治疗。新兴技术在技术成熟度上差异显著，从已建立到实验阶段不等，需进一步验证后方可常规应用。综述提出一个整合监测、诊断、风险评估、干预与再评估路径的框架，强调可持续养殖需将传统水处理设施与先进监测技术及预防性生物干预相结合，以改善鱼类健康、减少环境影响并促进负责任抗菌药物使用。

papers.title: Age, growth, fecundity, and host-fish confirmation for Potamilus streckersoni and Potamilus amphichaenus in Texas
papers.authors: Patterson, Donovan Aaron; Eismont, Anna; Robertson, Clint; Lopez, Roel; Randklev, Charles
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对德克萨斯州两种淡水贻贝（Potamilus streckersoni 和 Potamilus amphichaenus）开展生物学特性调查，旨在明确其年龄、生长、繁殖力及寄主鱼类关系。通过壳体年轮分析和繁殖生物学观测，获取了两种类的生长参数与繁殖力数据，并确认了其寄主鱼类种类。研究结果可为这两种贻贝的资源保护与管理提供基础生物学依据。

papers.title: Transcriptomic analysis revealed the protective role of genistein against oxidized fish oil-induced oxidative stress and inflammatory responses in turbot (Scophthalmus maximus)
papers.authors: Yang, Lin; Zhou, Xiaoqian; Hu, Junfeng; Jia, Ziyu; Jiang, Shuyun; Xu, Dan; Dan, Zhijie
papers.abstract: Introduction Extensive investigations have been conducted across mammalian species to explore the redox-modulating and inflammation-resolving properties of genistein and the mechanisms involved; however, research on the functions of this compound in aquatic species stay insufficient. Therefore, the present research was designed to determine whether oxidative liver injury and inflammatory immune reactions in turbot ( Scophthalmus maximus ) fed an oxidized fish oil diet could be ameliorated by genistein supplementation. Methods In this study, three dietary treatments were established: a fresh fish oil group (FFO), an oxidized fish oil group (OFO) in which fresh oil was completely replaced by oxidized oil, and a GEN40 group, where 40 mg/kg genistein was supplemented to the OFO basal diet. Juvenile turbot with an initial mean body mass of 10.00 ± 0.03 g were used in this study, and the feeding trial lasted 12 weeks. Results As revealed by the results, hepatic mitochondrial impairment was induced in turbot by oxidized fish oil ingestion, as reflected by reduced cristae number, cristae disorganization, and concentric cristae formation, while a significant increase in hepatic superoxide anion abundance was also noted ( P &lt; 0.05). These mitochondrial alterations were partially alleviated by genistein supplementation, with which a marked decrease in superoxide anion levels was concurrently observed ( P &lt; 0.05). Moreover, the hepatic mRNA levels linked to inflammation, oxidative stress, and apoptosis were markedly upregulated in the OFO group ( P &lt; 0.05), yet declined in the GEN40 group ( P &lt; 0.05). Transcriptomic analysis revealed that after genistein supplementation in oxidized fish oil-based diets, the DEGs were predominantly enriched in Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathways such as the Peroxisome Proliferator-Activated Receptor (PPAR), calcium signaling, and adrenergic signaling pathways. It was further revealed by Gene Ontology (GO) enrichment analysis that the OFO group chiefly suppressed lipid catabolism and signal transduction, while activating the immune response. Compared with the FFO group, the genistein-treated group downregulated lipid metabolism and upregulated substance transport processes. Relative to the OFO group, it downregulated signal transduction and upregulated RNA-related catalytic activities. Moreover, methionine-S-sulfhydryl reductase B2 ( msrb2 ) and heat shock protein 60 ( hspd1 ) were identified as hub genes through Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) and were associated with the genistein-mediated alleviation of hepatic oxidative and inflammatory stress that was triggered by oxidized fish oil in turbot. Discussion The above results confirmed that adding 40 mg/kg of genistein to an oxidized fish oil-based diet significantly alleviated hepatic oxidative stress and inflammatory injury mediated by the oxidized fish oil; besides msrb2 and hspd1 possibly served a critical function in this process.
